title: David awards Ziba everything that belonged to Mephibosheth
speaker: King David
note: Royal ruling on Ziba’s report (16:3), overturning AUD-10-9-9; later revised by first-pass P00802 (2 Samuel 19:30).

title: Absalom asks Ahithophel and his advisers for counsel
speaker: Absalom
note: Request answered by ot-2-samuel-v16-21; compare ot-2-samuel-v17-5, where Absalom consults Hushai.

title: Absalom summons Hushai for a second opinion
speaker: Absalom
note: Adds 17:6, the request itself (‘Should we act on his proposal? If not, you speak’); Hushai’s answer is first-pass P00793.

title: Absalom appoints Amasa over the army in Joab’s place
speaker: Absalom
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Reported appointment; David later promises Amasa the same command (ot-2-samuel-v19-14).

title: David appoints commanders and sends out the army in three divisions
speaker: King David
recipient: his people; Joab, Abishai and Ittai
note: Officers of thousands and hundreds appointed, thirds under three commanders; the troops’ reply is ot-2-samuel-v18-3, his order on Absalom AUD-10-18-5.

title: David asks Judah’s elders to bring him back
speaker: King David, through Zadok and Abiathar
note: Adds 19:13, the rest of the message: ‘You are my brothers… Why should you be the last to bring the king back?’

title: Israel’s tribes urge one another to bring King David back
speaker: the people throughout Israel’s tribes
note: Appeal in question form (‘Why are you silent now about bringing the king back?’, 19:11 context); it prompts ot-2-samuel-v19-12.

title: Barzillai asks to return home and sends Chimham in his place
speaker: Barzillai the Gileadite
note: Adds the opening of the same reply: his age, and his offer to cross only a little way (19:35–37).

title: Sheba son of Bichri calls Israel to desert David for their tents
speaker: Sheba son of Bichri
note: Rebel summons obeyed in 20:2; same cry as first-pass P00853 (1 Kings 12:16) but a different speaker and occasion.

title: Joab’s young man calls all loyal to David to follow Joab
speaker: one of Joab’s young men
note: Rallying call after Amasa’s murder; the men follow Joab once the body is moved (20:12–13).

title: David has Saul’s and Jonathan’s bones buried in Kish’s tomb
speaker: King David
recipient: those who carried out the burial
topic: Human life, injury and care for neighbours
note: Reported order: ‘They did everything the king commanded’ (21:14), including the bones of the seven executed; then God heeded the land.

title: David recounts God asking him to speak a parable about fearing God
speaker: David, recounting the Lord’s word
note: Adds the oracle’s opening (23:1–2: ‘David’s last words… The Spirit of the Lord spoke in me’); 23:2 is context.

title: David insists on buying Orna’s threshing floor for an altar
speaker: King David
note: Kings account of the purchase and of refusing a costless offering (24:24); first-pass P00982 extends the record to 1 Chronicles 21:24.

title: Zadok anoints Solomon king at Gihon
speaker: Zadok the priest
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Carries out David’s appointment (AUD-11-1-34); anointings are first-pass Commissions elsewhere (P00689, P00925). Jonathan reports it in 1:43–45.

title: David tells Solomon to hold Shimei to account
speaker: King David
note: Adds 2:8, which names Shimei, his curse and David’s oath; the Greek doublet is 1 Kings 2:35l–35o.

title: Solomon puts Benaiah over the army and Zadok in Abiathar’s place
speaker: King Solomon
recipient: Benaiah son of Jehoiada; Zadok the priest
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Verse 35 only, not 35a–o. Reported appointments after Joab’s death and Abiathar’s banishment; compare first-pass P00993 (1 Chronicles 29:22).

title: David’s charge to Solomon concerning Shimei’s punishment
speaker: King David
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Adds 2:35l–35n: ‘he commanded Solomon’, naming Shimei, his curse and David’s oath. 2:35h is noted at 1 Kings 5:27–30.

title: Hiram sends his attendants to anoint Solomon in David’s place
speaker: Hiram king of Tyre
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Greek-based reading ‘to anoint Solomon’: an embassy with a stated charge; compare first-pass P00771 (David’s envoys to Hanun).

title: Solomon asks Hiram to have cedar timber cut in Lebanon
speaker: King Solomon
note: Adds the message’s opening (5:16–19), as first pass extended the parallel ot-2-chronicles-v2-6 to 2:2–9; 5:19 also sits on ot-1-chronicles-v28-10.

title: Solomon levies Israelite workers for Lebanon and sets overseers over the works
speaker: King Solomon
recipient: the levy from all Israel, under Adoniram
note: Thirty thousand in monthly shifts (5:27 context). Parallel 2 Chronicles 2:16–17 is first-pass P00996; add 1 Kings 2:35h (3,600 overseers).

title: Solomon commands great costly stones brought for the temple’s foundation
speaker: King Solomon
note: Reported order (‘the king commanded’); Solomon’s and Hiram’s men hew and lay the stones (6:1b). 1 Kings 6 has no records.

title: Solomon sends for the bronze craftsman Hiram from Tyre
speaker: King Solomon
recipient: Hiram of Tyre, the bronze craftsman
note: Kings account of Solomon securing a skilled artisan from Tyre; first-pass P00996 records Hiram sending Huram-abi (2 Chronicles 2:12–13).

title: Solomon recounts God appointing David’s son to build the temple
speaker: the Lord, as recounted by Solomon
note: Adds 8:18, where the Lord’s word to David begins; first-pass P00998 includes the matching verse in its parallel 2 Chronicles 6:8–10.

title: Rehoboam answers Israel harshly, promising a heavier yoke and scorpions
speaker: King Rehoboam
note: Royal answer enacting the young men’s counsel (first-pass P00852); parallel 2 Chronicles 10:13–14 is also unrecorded (outside candidate list).

title: Rehoboam’s companions advise him to answer the people harshly
speaker: Rehoboam’s companions, the young men
note: Greek doublet of the young men’s counsel, noted but not proposed in first-pass P00852; the long Shemaiah record’s title does not cover it.

title: The old prophet tells his sons to saddle his donkey
speaker: the old prophet of Bethel
note: Household order before he overtakes the man of God; comparable orders are recorded at ot-2-kings-v4-24.

title: Asa sends gifts and asks Syria to break with Baasha
speaker: King Asa, through his attendants
recipient: the son of Ader, king of Syria
note: Adds 15:18: Asa sends the temple and palace silver and gold with envoys, ‘saying’. Same gap at 2 Chronicles 16:2.

title: Israel’s army makes its commander Omri king in the camp
speaker: the people in Israel’s camp
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: The people’s appointment of a king, like first-pass P00854 (1 Kings 12:20). 1 Kings 16 has no records.

title: Israel’s king proposes sending his men with Jehoshaphat’s on the ship
speaker: the king of Israel
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Proposal Jehoshaphat refuses; the only form of this exchange here, since this text lacks the parallel at English 1 Kings 22:49.

title: The Lord tells Elijah to hide at the Chorrath wadi
speaker: the Lord
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Adds 17:4, the rest of the instruction: drink from the wadi; the ravens will feed him there.

title: Elijah asks the widow to make him a small cake first
speaker: Elijah, citing the Lord’s promise
note: Adds the Lord’s promise grounding the request (‘For thus says the Lord’); first-pass P00865 extends to 17:10–13, so widen to 17:10–14.

title: Elijah tells Ahab to gather Israel and the prophets at Carmel
speaker: Elijah
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Adds 18:18, Elijah’s rebuke of Ahab’s Baal worship that opens the same reply and grounds the summons.

title: Elijah’s twelve stones recall the Lord’s word: Israel will be your name
speaker: the Lord, as recalled in the narrative
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Quotation of Jacob’s renaming (Genesis 32:29; 35:10), recalled as Elijah rebuilds the altar; link as Additional Scripture.

title: Jezebel’s letters order a fast and seat Naboth before the people
speaker: Jezebel, in letters sealed with Ahab’s seal
recipient: the elders and free men of Jezreel
note: Adds 20:8: she writes in Ahab’s name, seals and sends the letters; first-pass P00876 extends to 20:9–10, so widen to 20:8–10.

title: Jehoshaphat challenges Ahab’s dismissal of Micaiah and Ahab summons him
speaker: Jehoshaphat; the king of Israel
recipient: the king of Israel; his officer
note: Adds 22:7, Jehoshaphat’s request for a prophet of the Lord that opens the exchange; parallel 2 Chronicles 18:6–8 reported separately.

title: Jehoshaphat asks for a prophet of the Lord to inquire through
speaker: Jehoshaphat king of Judah
recipient: the king of Israel and his attendants
note: Request in question form; an attendant names Elisha and the kings go to him (ot-2-kings-v3-13). Compare first-pass P00884 (1 Kings 22:5).

title: Moab’s troops rally one another to plunder the allied camp
speaker: the Moabite troops
note: Battle cry ‘Now, Moab, to the spoils!’ after mistaking the red water for blood; they are routed (3:24).

title: The captive girl says Naaman should go to Samaria’s prophet
speaker: the young Israelite captive
note: Counsel in wish form, relayed to Naaman (5:4); it leads to ot-2-kings-v5-5.

title: The prophets ask Elisha to let them build by the Jordan
speaker: the sons of the prophets
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Adds 6:1, the opening of the same request (‘the place… is too narrow for us’); first-pass P00906 extends to 6:2–3.

title: Four men with leprosy decide to risk entering the Syrian camp
speaker: one of the four men with leprosy
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Adds 7:3, where the proposal begins: ‘Why are we sitting here until we die?’

title: Jehu’s letter dares Samaria’s leaders to crown Ahab’s son and fight
speaker: Jehu, by letter
recipient: the rulers, elders and guardians in Samaria
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Widens first-pass P00919 (10:2–3) to include 10:1, where Jehu writes and addresses the letter; one record, not two.

title: Jehu summons Baal’s worshipers under false pretenses
speaker: Jehu
recipient: all the people; Baal’s prophets, servants and priests
note: Adds 10:18, the feigned pledge to serve Baal ‘much’ that opens the summons; first-pass P00922 extends to 10:19–21.

title: Jehoiada binds the captains by covenant and shows them the king’s son
speaker: Jehoiada the priest
recipient: the captains of hundreds, the Chorri and the Rasim
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Kings account of the covenant and presentation of the king’s son (2 Chronicles 23:1–3); the guard orders follow at ot-2-kings-v11-5.

title: Judah’s people make the sixteen-year-old Azariah king
speaker: all the people of Judah
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list: the people’s appointment after Amaziah’s murder (14:19); parallel 2 Chronicles 26:1. Compare first-pass P00854.

title: Sennacherib sends his commanders with a great army against Jerusalem
speaker: the king of Assyria (Sennacherib)
note: The envoys’ commission behind ot-2-kings-v18-19 and the speeches that follow; parallel Isaiah 36:2 is also unrecorded.

title: Sennacherib warns Hezekiah against trusting God to save Jerusalem
speaker: Sennacherib, through messengers
note: Adds 19:9, where Sennacherib, hearing of Tharaka, sends the messengers ‘saying’; Isaiah 37:9 likewise precedes ot-isaiah-v37-10.

title: Manasseh appoints a charmer and mediums
speaker: King Manasseh
note: Wicked appointment among his sins, comparable to AUD-11-13-33 (Jeroboam’s priests); contrary to C1074. Parallel 2 Chronicles 33:6 unrecorded.

title: The people of the land make Josiah king after Amon’s murder
speaker: the people of the land
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list; parallel 2 Chronicles 33:25. Compare first-pass P00854 (Israel makes Jeroboam king).

title: Josiah sends his scribe to the high priest about the temple silver
speaker: King Josiah
note: Adds 22:3: the date and ‘the king sent Sapphan… saying’, which introduces the commission.

title: Josiah gathers Judah’s elders and reads the covenant book to all
speaker: King Josiah
recipient: the elders of Judah and Jerusalem; all the people
note: Reported summons and public reading (23:2 context) before the covenant, first-pass P00953 (23:3); parallel 2 Chronicles 34:29–30 unrecorded.

title: Jehoiakim taxes the land to pay the tribute Pharaoh demands
speaker: King Jehoiakim, at Pharaoh Neco’s command
note: Reported order (‘at Pharaoh’s command’) and assessment of each person; Pharaoh’s levy itself (23:33) is also unrecorded.

title: Pharaoh Neco makes Eliakim king and renames him Jehoiakim
speaker: Pharaoh Neco
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list (context verse): vassal king installed and renamed; compare first-pass P00956. Parallel 2 Chronicles 36:4.

title: The people of the land anoint Jehoahaz and make him king
speaker: the people of the land
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list: anointing by the people, like first-pass P00925 and P00963; parallel 2 Chronicles 36:1.

title: Nebuchadnezzar makes Mattaniah king and renames him Zedekiah
speaker: the king of Babylon
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list: vassal king installed and renamed, like 2 Kings 23:34; parallel 2 Chronicles 36:10. 2 Kings 24 has no records.

title: Aaron’s sons serve altar and Holy of Holies; Levites serve the tent
speaker: Moses, God’s servant (as recalled)
note: Restates the Mosaic division of duties ‘according to everything Moses commanded’ (6:33 context); link as Additional Scripture.

title: David sends Joab and the whole army against Ammon
speaker: King David
recipient: Joab and the army of mighty men
note: Reported dispatch answering Ammon’s hired Syrian force (19:6–7); parallel 2 Samuel 10:7 is also unrecorded.

title: Israel’s twelve army divisions serve the king in monthly turns
speaker: King David’s administration
recipient: the divisions of Israel and their officers
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list: rotation of 24,000 a month (27:2–15 name the commanders), like AUD-11-4-7; 1 Chronicles 27 has no records.

title: Humble yourselves, pray and turn, and the Lord will heal the land
speaker: the Lord
note: Widens first-pass P01001 (7:13–14) to include 7:12, where the Lord appears to Solomon and begins speaking; one record, not two.

title: Solomon offers as Moses commanded on Sabbaths, new moons and feasts
speaker: Moses (as recalled); Solomon complying
note: Restates the appointed-times offering law as kept, naming the three annual feasts (compare S050); link as Additional Scripture.

title: Solomon conscripts the Canaanite remnant but makes no Israelite a slave
speaker: King Solomon
recipient: the remaining Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites; Israel
note: Outside candidate list: royal labour policy echoing C1096 and C0732; Greek parallel 1 Kings 10:22a–c, also unrecorded, belongs as Additional Scripture.

title: Rehoboam’s young advisers tell him to answer the people harshly
speaker: King Rehoboam; the young men raised with him
note: Adds Rehoboam’s request for counsel (10:9) and the advisers’ closing lines (10:11, outside candidate list); 1 Kings 12:9 is likewise unrecorded.

title: Rehoboam sends Adoniram, overseer of the tribute, to Israel
speaker: King Rehoboam
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Parallel to first-pass P00853 (1 Kings 12:18); link as Additional Scripture on that record rather than a separate one.

title: Jeroboam expels the Levites and appoints his own high-place priests
speaker: Jeroboam
recipient: the Levites of Israel; his appointed priests
note: Chronicles account of the same high-place priesthood (1 Kings 12:31; 13:33); Abijah repeats the charge in 2 Chronicles 13:9.

title: Rehoboam appoints Abijah chief among his brothers, intending him as king
speaker: King Rehoboam
note: Reported appointment of an heir; 2 Chronicles 11 has records only at 11:3–4.

title: Abijah warns Israel that fighting the Lord will not prosper
speaker: King Abijah
note: Climax of the speech opened at ot-2-chronicles-v13-4 (Study Context): a warning not to fight ‘the Lord, our fathers’ God’.

title: Asa asks Syria’s king to make an alliance and drive Baasha away
speaker: King Asa
recipient: the son of Ader, king of Syria
note: Adds 16:2: Asa sends gold and silver from the temple and palace treasuries, ‘saying’; same gap as 1 Kings 15:18.

title: Hanani rebukes Asa for relying on Syria’s king instead of the Lord
speaker: Anani (Hanani) the prophet
note: 16:8–9 outside candidate list; 16:9 gives the maxim: the Lord’s eyes range the earth to strengthen every heart whole toward Him.

title: Jehoshaphat garrisons Judah’s fortified cities and appoints leaders
speaker: King Jehoshaphat
note: Reported appointments in Judah and the Ephraimite cities Asa took; his teaching commission is first-pass P01012 (17:7–9).

title: Jehoshaphat asks for another prophet and the king summons Micaiah
speaker: Jehoshaphat; the king of Israel
recipient: the king of Israel; his eunuch
note: Chronicles account of 1 Kings 22:7–9 (‘Quickly, Michaias son of Iemla!’); 18:7 already has a Study Context record.

title: Ahab adjures Micaiah to speak only the truth in the Lord’s name
speaker: the king of Israel (Ahab)
note: Parallel to first-pass P00886 (1 Kings 22:16); link as Additional Scripture on that record rather than a separate one.

summary: 70 findings (40 new, 21 extend, 9 parallel): 63 from 60 of 159 passages and seven wholly outside the candidate list, mostly unrecorded appointments, king-makings, reported orders, requests and speech-opening extends.
